title: 2-D transient conduction in a square (T11b), Robin faces, EXACT tier
capability_grid_cell: conduction x (laminar, n/a: no flow) x 2D transient (docs/capability/heat-transfer_GRID.md)

physics.referent: theta(x,y,Fo) = f(x,Fo) f(y,Fo), f the plane-wall series (exact_t14.py); cross-checked against T11's registered 1-D values

T14_SQ_f_CT.role: C-T temporal-bias control, REPORTED never gated

roache_floors.source: scripts/roache_triple.py, imported by name (MESH_STANDARD.md section 10.5, chief ruling 01967a7b); the comparator defines neither and REFUSES if these numbers differ from the import

G1.quantity: theta_mean, volume average over the quarter square (mesh-independent by construction)
G1.band_ground: T11 measured +4.4e-6 relative at N=100 on the 1-D mean (T11_PREREGISTRATION.md 6.1); the product doubles the relative error and N=50 quadruples it: coarse ~3.5e-5, medium ~9e-6, fine ~2.2e-6 predicted; the band 5e-5 is cleared by the fine level ~20x and by the coarse level ~1.4x -- a 1e-4 band would be cleared by every level and is not a gate

G2.quantity: theta at (x*,y*) = (0,0), the centre of the full square, separable linear extrapolation from the four nearest centres
G2.band_ground: T11's registered band for a pointwise row (interpolation error enters the triple and is disclosed)

G3.quantity: theta at (x*,y*) = (1,0), mid-face on the symmetry plane, separable linear extrapolation

C_CONV.what: every timestep's T solve final residual <= 1e-10 and an End line (gate (1) for a transient rung, T11 form)

W0.what: transposition symmetry witness: max |theta(x,y) - theta(y,x)| <= 1e-9 on every level; exceeding it means solver or reader asymmetry -> gate (1) NOT A RESULT

C_VF.what: valueFraction on each level READ FROM CASE.txt must equal Bi/(Bi+2N) (L-341); refuses otherwise

C_REF.what: Route B on the referent (PDE residual at two stencil widths falling as h^2, symmetry-plane gradients, Robin faces, initial condition, Simpson mean) plus CROSS-CHECK against T11's registered 1-D values to 1e-9; a 1 percent mutation of C_n is REFUSED (exact_t14.py --selftest)

C_PZ.what: planted-zero control per reader (rule 3, L-340): ALL-CELL plant for the averaging reader G1 (N_f^2 = 40 000 cells), one-cell plant for the point readers G2 (cell 0) and G3 (cell N_f-1); both arms; measured detection ladder; refuses a blind or noisy reader or a read below 0.1 x plant

C_T.what: temporal-bias control: T14_SQ_f_CT, deltaT halved at the fine level; movement of G1 REPORTED as a fraction of the band, never gated

predictions.P1: G1, G2, G3 all PASS: G1 inside +-5e-5 relative, G2/G3 inside +-1e-4
predictions.P2: all three triples CONVERGING with observed order p in [1.5, 2.5]
predictions.P3: C-T moves G1 by less than 10 percent of the G1 band (|move| < 5e-6 relative)
predictions.P4: W0 < 1e-12 on every level (the discrete problem is exactly symmetric)

cost.rate_T11_source: T11 MEASURED on its own coarse case: 5.255e-07 core-s per cell-step (T11_PREREGISTRATION.md section 10)
cost.usd_basis: derived, not measured, reported-by-owner rate (COMPUTE_BUDGET_CHARTER section 5)
cost.rate_scratch_source: MEASURED 2026-08-26T21:03Z on a SCRATCH COPY of T14_SQ_c (2 500 cells) run 2 000 steps through run_one_t14.sh under the queue runner's setsid/nohup/cd form: ExecutionTime 0.82 s, wall 1 s, rc=0 -> 1.64e-07 core-s per cell-step; outside the repository, no registered case touched
cost.note: caps are hang guards (rule 12 stops at the cap); the scratch rate is the POINT the calibration ledger compares against

completion.note: capped is an INFRASTRUCTURE field and never a completion conjunct (L-342)

launcher.guard: lineage-aware foreign-process scan (T10aR2 AMENDMENT 1, 9fa66065); driven on scratch 2026-08-26T21:03Z: ARM A (runner form) launched, solver rc=0, 2000 steps; ARM B (planted foreign sleep, cwd in the case) REFUSED exit 2 naming the pid, no STATUS written
